item.title: China Wholesale Inflation Reaches Highest Level in Over Four Years
item.description: China's producer price index climbed to 5.7% in October, exceeding the 5.3% consensus among economists surveyed by Reuters. At the same time, the country's consumer price measure showed signs of slowing.

item.title: Foreign Investors Buy Nearly $5 Billion in Indian Equities
item.description: Foreign institutional investors poured capital into India as market enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade weakened. Net equity purchases reached nearly $5 billion last week, according to provisional figures through Friday.

item.title: Philippine Economy Decelerates for Fifth Straight Quarter
item.description: Economic growth in the Philippines unexpectedly weakened for a fifth consecutive quarter, impacted by bad weather and the Iran war. The deceleration increases scrutiny on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and raises doubts regarding the central bank's rate-hike campaign.

item.title: Nvidia Probe Into CEO Huang Poses Overhang for AI Sector
item.description: Nvidia's board is currently reviewing Jensen Huang's connection to an alleged spy. Huang intends to stay on as chief executive while participating fully in the investigation.

item.title: Oil Prices Stabilize Following Steepest Weekly Decline Since April 2020
item.description: Crude oil prices held steady after suffering their sharpest weekly decline since April 2020. Market participants evaluated diplomatic attempts to resolve the US-Iran conflict alongside new regional strikes.

item.title: Nvidia Board Probes CEO Jensen Huang Over Relationship With Alleged Spy
item.description: Jensen Huang informed employees via email about an affair he had. The board subsequently launched an inquiry regarding claims that the woman involved is a spy for China.

item.title: Nvidia Investigation Threatens to Weigh on Asian Tech Equities
item.description: Asian equity markets face potential headwinds at the start of the week due to fresh concerns involving Nvidia Corp. The development follows an already difficult selloff across the broader technology sector.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar Gains Following Incumbent Party's Election Result
item.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened during early market trading after general election results emerged over the weekend. The ruling National Party secured a position that allows it to spearhead coalition talks with smaller parties.

item.title: Trump Links Avoidance of Iran Strikes to Progress in Nuclear Negotiations
item.description: President Donald Trump indicated that further military action against Iran is doubtful if diplomatic discussions advance. However, he cautioned that strikes remain an option if progress stalls.

item.title: US Treasuries Rally as Democratic Election Sweep Pressures AI Trade
item.description: A Democratic victory in the U.S. midterm elections has revitalized demand for Treasury debt. The political outcome has simultaneously battered the artificial intelligence trade.

item.title: Saudi Aramco Tower Damaged in Strike on Riyadh Financial Hub
item.description: A Houthi strike hit a landmark building in Riyadh's financial district, inflicting damage on a Saudi Aramco tower. The incident disrupts efforts to restore normalcy following earlier deadly strikes on the capital's airport that disrupted travel and canceled major events.

item.title: Europe's Aging Demographic Pressures Welfare and Public Budgets
item.description: European welfare systems face increasing financial pressure as demographic aging strains pensions and healthcare infrastructure. At the same time, regional governments struggle to cover costs for defense, infrastructure, and education.

item.title: S&P 500 Profit Beat Margins Drop to Four-Year Low
item.description: Most S&P 500 companies continue to surpass consensus earnings estimates from analysts. However, the degree of outperformance has shrunk to its narrowest margin in approximately four years.

item.title: Studies Find Multi-Agent AI Systems Can Pose Corporate Ethics Risks
item.description: Automated artificial intelligence agents are increasingly collaborating in business environments. However, research reveals these cooperating systems do not always share identical objectives or adhere to ethical principles.

item.title: U.S. Stocks Align in Sync Amid Worst Market Selloff in Over a Year
item.description: U.S. equities have begun trading with unified direction after experiencing an extended phase of divergence. This synchronized movement has developed alongside the steepest market decline observed in over twelve months.

item.title: Poppi Founders Launch Hydration Brand Jetty to Rival Gatorade
item.description: Allison and Stephen Ellsworth have introduced a new beverage company focused on hydration products. The brand's bottled beverages and powders will be carried by retailers such as Whole Foods, Target, and Amazon.

item.title: Democratic US Congress Challenges Trump-Linked Latin America Trades
item.description: A shift to a Democratic-controlled United States Congress has introduced a new dynamic for regional investment strategies. Market participants had previously built Latin America positions based on regional relationships with Donald Trump.

item.title: House Democrats Prioritize Ending Trump Tariffs Under Hakeem Jeffries
item.description: Representative Hakeem Jeffries indicated that rolling back President Trump's tariffs stands as a primary agenda item for Democrats. Jeffries is viewed as likely to become the next House speaker.

item.title: Amazon Builds New Team to Develop Consumer Robotics Products
item.description: Job listings reveal that the company is hiring personnel for an entirely new home robotics offering. The initiative follows the Astro home robot, which gained some fans but appears headed for the discard pile.

item.title: Record-Low Stock Correlations Signal Potential Market Volatility Ahead
item.description: A metric that previously foreshadowed a decline in technology equities is flashing a fresh cautionary signal. Relationships between individual share price movements have dropped to historically low levels.

item.title: French Demonstrations Over Living Costs Draw 146,000 for Fourth Weekend
item.description: France's Interior Ministry reported that 146,000 people took part in protests on Saturday across the country. The demonstrations over living costs and public services have now continued for four weekends in a row.

item.title: Saudi Aramco Riyadh Facility Incurs Limited Damage in Attack
item.description: Saudi Aramco's offices in Riyadh sustained minor damage following an attack on Sunday. The incident occurred amid renewed strikes directed at Saudi Arabia from Houthi forces in Yemen.

item.title: China Projected to Top Global Energy Investment in 2026
item.description: China is forecast to deploy $940 billion into energy projects in 2026, leading global spending. The projection was detailed in a report released by the China Enterprise Reform and Development Society and broadcast by state media.

item.title: AI Downturn Sparks Renewed Interest in China and India Stocks
item.description: A retreat in artificial intelligence assets following US midterm elections has prompted market participants to adjust their regional strategies. This shift has reignited interest in previously overlooked equities in China and India, alongside firms exposed to cooling inflation and lower trade tension.

item.title: Australia Home Sales and Auction Clearances Edge Upward
item.description: Australian residential transactions and auction clearance rates recorded gains in recent tracking. The improvement provides early indications of potential stabilization for a sector hit by rising interest rates this year.

item.title: Meta Strategy Chief Dave Wehner Departs for AI Startup Fireworks
item.description: Meta's chief strategy officer Dave Wehner is stepping down from his post. He is joining Fireworks, an artificial intelligence infrastructure startup that reached a $17.5 billion valuation in July, as its chief financial officer.

item.title: Meta executes $25 billion bond offering
item.description: Meta Platforms completed a $25 billion corporate bond sale on Election Day. The timing of the issuance was noted as unusual given the market environment.

item.title: IRS releases 2027 capital gains tax brackets
item.description: The IRS has published the capital gains tax rates applicable to various income levels for the 2027 tax year. Taxpayers can now review these updated figures for future planning.

item.title: Market analysis on tech sector and political shifts
item.description: Industry experts and analysts discussed the implications of recent political appointments and market volatility. The conversation covered the tech sector's performance and broader economic context.

item.title: Wealthiest Decile of Americans Sees Median Net Worth Rise by $800,000
item.description: Data reveals the top 10% of households widened their financial advantage relative to the remainder of the population. Their median net worth experienced an increase of $800,000 over a three-year span.
